earlierTrials: 1.1.2 passed 110 installed backend tests and four JavaScript suites.
Initial interaction harness runs encountered foreground focus and startup timing errors. Persistent fixture reset replaced repeated window recreation; failures were retained as harness evidence.
A later 1.1.2 clone passed 11/12 desktop cases; its cold startup heartbeat failure led to the 1.1.3 fix. The full 12-case suite passed on a fresh 1.1.3 clone.

One gated retry initially consumed a replayed last-task status because a task ID was reused. The harness now uses UUID task IDs and stops any previous dedicated test task before starting. This harness failure is separate from the recorded live provider error.
limitations: One transient live provider error occurred; successful retry does not establish broad service reliability.
Cold startup took 53 seconds in the 4 GB VM; no performance guarantee is implied.
No Windows 10, multi-monitor, elevated target application or broad arbitrary-photo benchmark was performed.
Unsigned installer was copied into the VM; browser-download SmartScreen/Mark-of-the-Web behavior was not tested.
The 1.1.4 high-effort default was applied after the successful 1.1.3 low-effort VM tests. No tests were rerun after this configuration change, as explicitly requested by the user.
